exact_blocker: The live-first latent-route repair was hard-coded to /past-auctions/archive/page-14 even though the surviving first-party page-13 route currently exposes the oldest directly verifiable dated auction-result cards (down to 24 April 2014). As a result, a page-14 fetch/Playwright timeout could consume the latent-probe step without inspecting the concrete live page-13 HTML for catalogue/form/data/script routes.
repair: Retarget the latent first-party route probe to the concrete surviving page-13 archive route and run it before any Common Crawl or broad legacy-ID archaeology. Keep archive-summary cards non-ingestable unless a surviving Savills lot/catalogue endpoint is recovered.
next_probe: Inspect page-13 href, data-*, form action, onclick and embedded script URL values; resolve any surviving first-party catalogue/commission/LotList route and ingest commercial or mixed-use lots into History V2. If none exist, persist that exact page-13 route exhaustion before moving to the next live page/first-party bridge.
evidence_policy: No property event may be created from the aggregate archive card alone; canonical History V2 requires lot-level surviving Savills evidence.
